```{r Filtering and preparing KLDB data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cmdstanr)



# keep only relevant columns
kldb_data <- data_basis %>%
  select(item_id, kldb_tool_1st, res1_kldb_1st, res2_kldb_1st)

#Rename columns
setnames(
  data_basis,
  old = c("kldb_tool_1st", "res1_kldb_1st", "res2_kldb_1st"),
  new = c("kldb_tool", "kldb_human1", "kldb_human2")
)

head(data_basis)

#### 1) Select only KLDB, as character
kldb_data <- data_basis %>%
  dplyr::select(item_id, kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) %>%
  mutate(across(c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool), as.character))

### Remove all lines with NAs
kldb_data <- kldb_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(kldb_human1) & !is.na(kldb_human2) & !is.na(kldb_tool))

# Keep only two categories: "7" and "8"
kldb_data <- kldb_data %>%
  filter(kldb_human1 == "7" | kldb_human1 == "8") %>%
  filter(kldb_human2 == "7" | kldb_human2 == "8") %>%
  filter(kldb_tool   == "7" | kldb_tool   == "8")

# 1) Number of rows where all three classify as "7"
count_all_7 <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(kldb_human1 == "7", kldb_human2 == "7", kldb_tool == "7") %>%
  nrow()

# 2) Number of rows where all three classify as "8"
count_all_8 <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(kldb_human1 == "8", kldb_human2 == "8", kldb_tool == "8") %>%
  nrow()

# 3) Number of rows where at least one value is "7" and at least one value is "8"
count_mixed_7_and_8 <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    any(c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) == "7") &
      any(c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) == "8")
  ) %>%
  nrow()

# 4) Number of rows where minimum one element is neither "7" nor "8" - should be 0
count_other <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    any(!c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) %in% c("7", "8"))
  ) %>%
  nrow()

# Show results
count_all_7         #  225
count_all_8         #  242
count_mixed_7_and_8 #  4
count_other         #  0 

# print the observations where 7 and 8 are mixed
kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    any(c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) == "7") &
      any(c(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) == "8")
  )

# Reindex item_id (1, 2, 3,...)
kldb_data <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(item_id = dplyr::row_number())

# Collect all observed classes
kldb_levels <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::select(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort() %>%
  as.character() %>%
  as.vector()

# K, number of distinct classes
K <- length(kldb_levels)
stopifnot(K >= 2)

# Helper: map original labels to 1..K using kldb_levels for stan compatibility
to_index <- function(v) as.integer(factor(v, levels = kldb_levels))

# 1) Map original labels to 1..K
kldb_data_idx <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    kldb_human1 = to_index(kldb_human1),
    kldb_human2 = to_index(kldb_human2),
    kldb_tool   = to_index(kldb_tool)
  )

# 2) Long format (now without NAs)
long_data <- kldb_data_idx %>%
  dplyr::transmute(item_id, r1 = kldb_human1, r2 = kldb_human2, r3 = kldb_tool) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("r"), names_to = "rater", values_to = "y") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rater_id = as.integer(factor(rater, levels = c("r1", "r2", "r3")))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(item_id, rater_id)

# Robust 1..I indexing
item_ids <- sort(unique(long_data$item_id))
long_data$item_id_idx <- as.integer(factor(long_data$item_id, levels = item_ids))

I <- length(item_ids) # number of items (people interviewed)
J <- 3L # number of raters
N <- nrow(long_data) # number of observations (I * J if no missing)

cat("Items after filtering:", I, "\n")
cat("Observations:", N, "\n")
cat("Classes:", K, "\n")
cat("Class levels:", paste(kldb_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Output folder for descriptive plots of the 7 vs 8 subset (KldB)
out_dir_desc <- "img/data_descriptive_plots/kldb/two_categories"
dir.create(out_dir_desc, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Color scheme consistent with your other script
agreement_palette <- c("match" = "darkblue", "mismatch" = "darkred")

# Helper: pairwise agreement (counts + mismatch percent)
pair_agreement <- function(df, a, b, label) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[a]]), !is.na(.data[[b]])) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      match = sum(.data[[a]] == .data[[b]]),
      mismatch = sum(.data[[a]] != .data[[b]]),
      total = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      mismatch_pct = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * mismatch / total, NA_real_),
      pair = label
    )
}

# Pairwise agreements (two-way)
kldb_pairs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pair_agreement(kldb_data, "kldb_human1", "kldb_human2", "Human 1 vs Human 2"),
  pair_agreement(kldb_data, "kldb_human1", "kldb_tool",   "Human 1 vs Tool"),
  pair_agreement(kldb_data, "kldb_human2", "kldb_tool",   "Human 2 vs Tool")
)

print(kldb_pairs)

# Long format for plotting counts
kldb_pairs_long <- kldb_pairs %>%
  dplyr::select(pair, match, mismatch, total, mismatch_pct) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(match, mismatch), names_to = "status", values_to = "count") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    status = factor(status, levels = c("mismatch", "match")),
    match_pct = 100 - mismatch_pct,
    label = ifelse(
      status == "match",
      paste0(round(match_pct, 1), "% match"),
      paste0(round(mismatch_pct, 1), "% mismatch")
    ),
    pair_label = paste0(pair, "\n(n=", total, ")")
  )

# Counts plot
p_kldb_pairs <- ggplot(kldb_pairs_long, aes(x = pair_label, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = agreement_palette, breaks = c("match", "mismatch"),
                    labels = c("Match", "Mismatch")) +
  labs(
    title = "KldB (7 vs 8): Pairwise agreement",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of observations",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = "Times") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_desc, "kldb_78_pairwise_agreement_counts.png"),
       p_kldb_pairs, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 600)
print(p_kldb_pairs)

# Percentage version
kldb_pairs_pct <- kldb_pairs_long %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * count / total, NA_real_))

p_kldb_pairs_pct <- ggplot(kldb_pairs_pct, aes(x = pair_label, y = pct, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = agreement_palette, breaks = c("match", "mismatch"),
                    labels = c("Match", "Mismatch")) +
  labs(
    title = "KldB (7 vs 8): Pairwise agreement",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 11, base_family = "Times") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  ylim(0, 100)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_desc, "kldb_78_pairwise_agreement_pct.png"),
       p_kldb_pairs_pct, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 600)
print(p_kldb_pairs_pct)

# Three-way agreement
kldb_tri <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(kldb_human1), !is.na(kldb_human2), !is.na(kldb_tool)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(all_three_match = (kldb_human1 == kldb_human2) & (kldb_human2 == kldb_tool)) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    match = sum(all_three_match),
    mismatch = sum(!all_three_match),
    total = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mismatch_pct = ifelse(total > 0, 100 * mismatch / total, NA_real_))

print(kldb_tri)

kldb_tri_long <- kldb_tri %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(match, mismatch), names_to = "status", values_to = "count") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    status = factor(status, levels = c("mismatch", "match")),
    match_pct = 100 - mismatch_pct,
    label = ifelse(
      status == "match",
      paste0(round(match_pct, 1), "% match"),
      paste0(round(mismatch_pct, 1), "% mismatch")
    ),
    pct = ifelse(status == "match", match_pct, mismatch_pct),
    status_label = factor(ifelse(status == "match", "Match", "Mismatch"),
                          levels = c("Mismatch", "Match"))
  )

# Counts plot
p_kldb_tri <- ggplot(kldb_tri_long, aes(x = status_label, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = agreement_palette, breaks = c("match", "mismatch"),
                    labels = c("Match", "Mismatch")) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("KldB (7 vs 8): Three-way agreement (n=", kldb_tri$total[1], ")"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of observations",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = "Times") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_desc, "kldb_78_three_way_agreement_counts.png"),
       p_kldb_tri, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
print(p_kldb_tri)

# Percentage plot
p_kldb_tri_pct <- ggplot(kldb_tri_long, aes(x = status_label, y = pct, fill = status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = agreement_palette, breaks = c("match", "mismatch"),
                    labels = c("Match", "Mismatch")) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("KldB (7 vs 8): Three-way agreement (n=", kldb_tri$total[1], ")"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light(base_size = 11, base_family = "Times") +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)) +
  ylim(0, 100)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_desc, "kldb_78_three_way_agreement_pct.png"),
       p_kldb_tri_pct, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
print(p_kldb_tri_pct)
```

```{r Modeling with Dawid-Skene in Stan - All 4 Models, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Packages
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(cmdstanr)



# 3) Write Stan model to file
stan_file <- "dawid_skene_kldb.stan"
writeLines(con = stan_file, text = '
  data {
    int<lower=2> K;                      // number of categories
    int<lower=1> I;                      // items
    int<lower=1> J;                      // raters
    int<lower=1> N;                      // number of observed ratings
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=I> ii;   // item index per observation
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=J> jj;   // rater index per observation
    array[N] int<lower=1, upper=K> y;    // observed category per observation
  
    vector<lower=0>[K] alpha;            // prior for pi
    array[K] vector<lower=0>[K] beta;    // Dirichlet priors for theta rows, vary by true class
  }

parameters {
  simplex[K] pi;                       // prevalence over true classes
  array[J, K] simplex[K] theta;        // confusion rows: for rater j and true class k
}

transformed parameters {
  // log_q_z[i, k] = log p(z_i = k | pi, theta) up to a constant
  array[I] vector[K] log_q_z;

  // Initialize with log pi
  for (i in 1:I) {
    log_q_z[i] = log(pi);
  }

  // Accumulate per observation
  for (n in 1:N) {
    int i = ii[n];
    int j = jj[n];
    int y_n = y[n];
    for (k in 1:K) {
      // Add log categorical pmf of y_n under theta[j, k, :]
      log_q_z[i, k] += categorical_lpmf(y_n | theta[j, k]);
    }
  }
}

model {
  // Priors
  pi ~ dirichlet(alpha);
  for (j in 1:J)
    for (k in 1:K)
      theta[j, k] ~ dirichlet(beta[k]);

  // Marginalized likelihood
  for (i in 1:I) {
    target += log_sum_exp(log_q_z[i]);
  }
}

generated quantities {
  array[I] simplex[K] q_z;
  for (i in 1:I) {
    vector[K] lq = log_q_z[i];
    q_z[i] = softmax(lq);
  }
}
')

# Compile model once
mod <- cmdstan_model(stan_file, cpp_options = list(stan_threads = TRUE))

# Define 4 model configurations
model_configs <- list(
  list(
    name = "alpha11_beta1",
    alpha = c(1.0, 1.0),
    beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K)  # uniform: 1 everywhere
  )
  # list(
  #   name = "alpha11_beta5diag",
  #   alpha = c(1.0, 1.0),
  #   beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K) + diag(4.0, K)  # 5 on diagonal, 1 elsewhere
  # ),
  # list(
  #   name = "alpha1510_beta1",
  #   alpha = c(15.0, 10.0),
  #   beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K)
  # ),
  # list(
  #   name = "alpha1510_beta5diag",
  #   alpha = c(15.0, 10.0),
  #   beta = matrix(1.0, nrow = K, ncol = K) + diag(4.0, K)  # 5 on diagonal, 1 elsewhere
  # )
)

# Fit all 1 models
fits <- list()
for (config in model_configs) {
  cat("\n=== Fitting model:", config$name, "===\n")
  
  stan_data <- list(
    I = I,
    J = J,
    K = K,
    N = N,
    ii = as.integer(long_data$item_id_idx),
    jj = as.integer(long_data$rater_id),
    y  = as.integer(long_data$y),
    alpha = config$alpha,
    beta  = config$beta
  )
  
  fit <- mod$sample(
    data = stan_data,
    seed = 1234,
    chains = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    threads_per_chain = 1,
    iter_warmup = 1000,
    iter_sampling = 4000,
    refresh = 200,
    adapt_delta = 0.99
  )
  
  fits[[config$name]] <- fit
  
  # Check convergence
  s <- fit$summary()
  s$rhat <- as.numeric(s$rhat)
  bad_rhat <- subset(s, rhat > 1.1 & grepl("^(pi|theta)\\b", variable))
  if (nrow(bad_rhat) > 0) {
    cat("WARNING: R-hat values above 1.1:\n")
    print(bad_rhat[, c("variable","rhat","ess_bulk","ess_tail")])
  } else {
    cat("No R-hat values above 1.1\n")
  }
}
```


```{r Posterior summaries and analysis - BASIS, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE} 
library(dplyr)
library(posterior)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

out_dir <- "img/model_results/kldb/two_categories"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# use first fit 
fit_basis <- fits[["alpha11_beta1"]]

save_plot <- function(p, filename, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, filename),
    plot = p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Basic diagnostics for key parameters
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_tbl <- fit_basis$summary(variables = c("pi", "theta")) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail)

diag_bad <- diag_tbl %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(rhat), rhat > 1.01) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(rhat))

diag_bad

# Divergences, treedepth hits, if available (cmdstanr)
div_info <- tryCatch(fit_basis$diagnostic_summary(), error = function(e) NULL)
if (is.null(div_info)) {
  div_info <- tryCatch(fit_basis$cmdstan_diagnose(), error = function(e) NULL)
}
div_info

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Confusion matrices (theta), posterior mean and uncertainty
# ------------------------------------------------------------
theta_draws_mat <- fit_basis$draws("theta", format = "draws_matrix")
theta_mean_vec  <- colMeans(theta_draws_mat)

# Expectation: theta has dimensions [J rater, K true, K given]
theta_mean_arr <- array(
  theta_mean_vec,
  dim = c(J, K, K),
  dimnames = list(
    rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
    true  = kldb_levels,
    given = kldb_levels
  )
)

theta_human1_mean <- theta_mean_arr["human1", , ]
theta_human2_mean <- theta_mean_arr["human2", , ]
theta_tool_mean   <- theta_mean_arr["tool",   , ]

theta_human1_mean
rowSums(theta_human1_mean)

theta_human2_mean
rowSums(theta_human2_mean)

theta_tool_mean
rowSums(theta_tool_mean)

plot_theta <- function(mat, title_txt) {
  long <- reshape2::melt(mat, varnames = c("True", "Given"), value.name = "Prob")
  ggplot(long, aes(x = Given, y = True, fill = Prob)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen") +
    theme_light() +
    labs(
      title = title_txt,
      x = "Observed class",
      y = "True class C_i"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

p_theta_h1_mean <- plot_theta(theta_human1_mean, "Confusion matrix pi^(1) (posterior mean)")
p_theta_h2_mean <- plot_theta(theta_human2_mean, "Confusion matrix pi^(2) (posterior mean)")
p_theta_tool_mean <- plot_theta(theta_tool_mean, "Confusion matrix pi^(3) (posterior mean)")

save_plot(p_theta_h1_mean, "theta_human1_mean.png")
save_plot(p_theta_h2_mean, "theta_human2_mean.png")
save_plot(p_theta_tool_mean, "theta_tool_mean.png")

p_theta_h1_mean
p_theta_h2_mean
p_theta_tool_mean

# Credible intervals for all theta entries
theta_summ <- summarise_draws(
  as_draws_df(fit_basis$draws("theta")),
  mean, sd,
  ~quantile(.x, probs = c(`5%` = 0.05, `50%` = 0.50, `95%` = 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)
)
theta_summ

# Posterior SD heatmaps for theta (uncertainty by cell)
theta_sd_vec <- apply(theta_draws_mat, 2, sd)
theta_sd_arr <- array(
  theta_sd_vec,
  dim = c(J, K, K),
  dimnames = list(
    rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
    true  = kldb_levels,
    given = kldb_levels
  )
)

p_theta_h1_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["human1", , ], "Confusion matrix pi^(1) (posterior SD)")
p_theta_h2_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["human2", , ], "Confusion matrix pi^(2) (posterior SD)")
p_theta_tool_sd <- plot_theta(theta_sd_arr["tool", , ], "Confusion matrix pi^(3) (posterior SD)")

save_plot(p_theta_h1_sd, "theta_human1_sd.png")
save_plot(p_theta_h2_sd, "theta_human2_sd.png")
save_plot(p_theta_tool_sd, "theta_tool_sd.png")

p_theta_h1_sd
p_theta_h2_sd
p_theta_tool_sd

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Class prevalence (pi), posterior mean and uncertainty
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pi_summ <- summarise_draws(
  as_draws_df(fit_basis$draws("pi")),
  mean, sd,
  ~quantile(.x, probs = c(`5%` = 0.05, `50%` = 0.50, `95%` = 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)
)
pi_summ

pi_means <- colMeans(as_draws_matrix(fit_basis$draws("pi")))
pi_df <- data.frame(
  class = kldb_levels,
  prevalence = as.numeric(pi_means)
)

p_pi_bar <- ggplot(pi_df, aes(x = class, y = prevalence)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#02626f") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior mean of class prevalence (p)",
    x = "Class",
    y = "Prevalence"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

save_plot(p_pi_bar, "pi_mean_bar.png", width = 6, height = 4)
p_pi_bar

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2b) Rater level scalar summaries from theta
# ------------------------------------------------------------
pi_mean_vec <- as.numeric(pi_means)
names(pi_mean_vec) <- kldb_levels

weighted_diag_mass <- function(mat, w) sum(diag(mat) * w)
weighted_offdiag_mass <- function(mat, w) sum((1 - diag(mat)) * w)

rater_summary <- data.frame(
  rater = c("human1", "human2", "tool"),
  weighted_diag_mass = c(
    weighted_diag_mass(theta_human1_mean, pi_mean_vec),
    weighted_diag_mass(theta_human2_mean, pi_mean_vec),
    weighted_diag_mass(theta_tool_mean,   pi_mean_vec)
  ),
  weighted_offdiag_mass = c(
    weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_human1_mean, pi_mean_vec),
    weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_human2_mean, pi_mean_vec),
    weighted_offdiag_mass(theta_tool_mean,   pi_mean_vec)
  )
)
rater_summary

p_rater_diag <- ggplot(rater_summary, aes(x = rater, y = weighted_diag_mass)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#02626f") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Rater summary: Weighted diagonal mass",
    x = "Rater",
    y = "Weighted diagonal mass"
  )

save_plot(p_rater_diag, "rater_weighted_diag_mass.png", width = 6, height = 4)
p_rater_diag

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Posterior class probabilities per item (q_i,j = P(C_i = j | data))
# ------------------------------------------------------------
qz_draws_mat <- fit_basis$draws("q_z", format = "draws_matrix")
qz_mean_vec  <- colMeans(qz_draws_mat)

qz_mean <- matrix(
  qz_mean_vec,
  nrow = I, ncol = K,
  dimnames = list(item = item_ids, class = kldb_levels)
)

qz_df <- as.data.frame(qz_mean)
p_cols <- paste0("p_", kldb_levels)
colnames(qz_df) <- p_cols
qz_df$item_id <- item_ids

# MAP label
qz_df$map_class_idx   <- max.col(qz_df[p_cols], ties.method = "first")
qz_df$map_class_label <- kldb_levels[qz_df$map_class_idx]

# Uncertainty measures
eps <- 1e-12
qz_df$max_p <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, max)

qz_df$entropy <- -rowSums(as.matrix(qz_df[p_cols]) * log(as.matrix(qz_df[p_cols]) + eps))

qz_df$margin <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, function(p) {
  ps <- sort(p, decreasing = TRUE)
  ps[1] - ps[2]
})

# Credible set per item, smallest set reaching cumulative posterior mass >= level
credible_set <- function(p, classes, level = 0.95) {
  o <- order(p, decreasing = TRUE)
  cum <- cumsum(p[o])
  m <- which(cum >= level)[1]
  classes[o[seq_len(m)]]
}
qz_df$cs95 <- apply(qz_df[p_cols], 1, function(x) credible_set(x, kldb_levels, level = 0.95))

table(lengths(qz_df$cs95))

# Plots of uncertainty and confidence
p_maxp_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = max_p)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "Posterior max probability", y = "Count",
       title = "Model confidence per item")

p_entropy_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = entropy)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "Posterior entropy", y = "Count",
       title = "Item uncertainty (entropy)")

p_margin_hist <- ggplot(qz_df, aes(x = margin)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, fill = "#333333", color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(x = "Posterior margin (top1 minus top2)", y = "Count",
       title = "Item uncertainty (margin)")

save_plot(p_maxp_hist, "qz_maxp_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)
save_plot(p_entropy_hist, "qz_entropy_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)
save_plot(p_margin_hist, "qz_margin_hist.png", width = 6, height = 4)

p_maxp_hist
p_entropy_hist
p_margin_hist

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3b) MAP distribution vs pi (sanity check)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
map_tab <- qz_df %>%
  count(map_class_label, name = "n_map") %>%
  mutate(map_share = n_map / sum(n_map)) %>%
  rename(class = map_class_label)

pi_tab <- data.frame(class = kldb_levels, pi_mean = as.numeric(pi_means))

map_vs_pi <- left_join(map_tab, pi_tab, by = "class")
map_vs_pi

p_map_vs_pi <- ggplot(map_vs_pi, aes(x = class)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = map_share), fill = "#02626f") +
  geom_point(aes(y = pi_mean), size = 2) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "MAP share (bars) vs posterior mean p (points)",
    x = "Class",
    y = "Share / prevalence"
  )

save_plot(p_map_vs_pi, "map_share_vs_pi.png", width = 6, height = 4)
p_map_vs_pi

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Merge predictions with original ratings, include uncertainty
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ratings <- kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::select(item_id, kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool)

predictions <- qz_df %>%
  dplyr::select(item_id, map_class_label, all_of(p_cols), max_p, entropy, margin, cs95)

ratings_with_predictions <- ratings %>%
  dplyr::left_join(predictions, by = "item_id") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    predicted_class = map_class_label,
    rating_human1 = kldb_human1,
    rating_human2 = kldb_human2,
    rating_tool   = kldb_tool
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(item_id)

head(ratings_with_predictions, 30)

# Most uncertain items by entropy, include posterior probabilities
most_uncertain <- ratings_with_predictions %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(entropy)) %>%
  dplyr::select(item_id, predicted_class, entropy, margin, max_p, all_of(p_cols),
                rating_human1, rating_human2, rating_tool)

head(most_uncertain, 20)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Observed agreement, descriptive, not model based
# ------------------------------------------------------------
mean(kldb_data$kldb_human1 == kldb_data$kldb_tool, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(kldb_data$kldb_human2 == kldb_data$kldb_tool, na.rm = TRUE)

kldb_data %>%
  dplyr::count(kldb_human1, kldb_human2, kldb_tool) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n))

```
